name: Being A Good Parent
overview: Scripture reveals that being a good parent begins with loving the Lord wholeheartedly, as shown in Deuteronomy 6:5, which forms the foundation for guiding children. Children are described as a heritage and reward from the Lord (Psalms 127:3), emphasizing their sacred value. Parents are instructed to train their children in the right way so they remain steadfast in it throughout life (Proverbs 22:6), while also modeling godly conduct by avoiding ungodly counsel (Psalms 1:1). The principle of treating others as we would like to be treated (Matthew 7:12) further underscores the importance of love and respect in parenting.
